Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a Redis cache: StatefulSet, headless Service, PersistentVolumeClaim, and a Secret for the Redis password.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
name: redis-cache
version: 1.0.0
description: A Helm chart for deploying a Redis cache
type: application
appVersion: 6.2.6

---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: redis
  tag: 6.2.6
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 6379
persistentVolumeClaim:
  enabled: true
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
secret:
  password: "redis-password"

---
# FILE: templates/statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis-cache.fullname" . }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: {{ include "redis-cache.name" . }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: {{ include "redis-cache.name" . }}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
        ports:
        - containerPort: {{ .Values.service.port }}
        env:
        - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: {{ include "redis-cache.fullname" . }}
              key: password
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: data
    spec:
      accessModes: [ "ReadWriteOnce" ]
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: {{ .Values.persistentVolumeClaim.resources.requests.storage }}

---
# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis-cache.fullname" . }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
  - port: {{ .Values.service.port }}
    targetPort: {{ .Values.service.port }}
  selector:
    app: {{ include "redis-cache.name" . }}

---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis-cache.fullname" . }}
type: Opaque
data:
  password: {{ .Values.secret.password | b64enc }}

---
# FILE: templates/persistentvolumeclaim.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "redis-cache.fullname" . }}-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.persistentVolumeClaim.resources.requests.storage }}
